sections.label: head
sections.text:
Dull, stretching sensation as of a board before the
forehead. Passing attacks of vertigo in quick succession,

114 PLATINA.

in the evening when standing, as if he would lose his
consciousness. Violent vertigo, she dares not move her
eyes, more in day time than in the night, generally when
she is attacked with palpitation of the heart. Headache
after the vertigo, as if torn and pulled into shreds. Pass-
ing headache over the left eye-brow. Headache, as if
the head were jammed in, a dull pain. Tensive numb
feeling in the whole occiput, as after a blow, extending as
far as the nasal bone. Numb feeling in the sinciput, as
if constricted, in a warm room full of men, increased after
a sort time to a violent pressing together with a sensation
as of a dull digging-up, with impatience and ill-humor and
heat on the upper part of the body, especially in the head,
as if the sweat of anguish would break out ; in the even-
ing, when in the cool air, he feels an unusual heat, and
when beginning to walk, . a painful vibratory shaking of
the brain, as if knocking against the skull like a ball ;
afterwards the same sensation is felt when lying in the
bed, accompanied with a slight roaring in the ears ; while
the pain abates he falls asleep. A cramp-like contraction
suddenly darts through the head from the right temple to
the left ; afterwards feeling of numbness as if the head
were tied too fast, with tremulousness of both sides of the

sections.label: head
sections.text:
Cramp-pain in the right temple, in the afternoon.
Cramp-pain in the forehead, as if between screws. Cramp-
like drawing constriction in the head from time to time,
especially around the forehead ; it begins feebly, increases
in violence and ends feebly. Cramp-like pressing in the
temples from without inwards. Cramp-like tension in the
temples, as if between screws. Compression in the fore-
head, in paroxysms. Violent pressing in the forehead, as
if everything in the forehead would come out, with sensa-
tion as if a load were pressing upon the head, pressing
upon the eyes and closing them, and pressing out tears ;
increased by stooping and by making the slightest move-
ment with the head ; the fit is preceded by anguish about
the heart, and a sensation as if knocked against the fore-
head, preventing her from talking ; with the increasing
anguish accompanied with burning heat and bright Ted-
ness of the face and violent thirst, the headache increases
likewise until 10 o'clock in the evening ; the pain recurred


115

for several days at the same hour. Sudden and short
pressing from without inwards in the vertex. Sudden,
dull pressing into the left side of the forehead, (a. 3 h.)
Undulating pressing into the left temple. Pressure under
the left Irontal eminence, increasing and decreasing in
paroxysms. Headache, as if she had water in her head,
about midnight, accompanied by great dryness and in-
tensely painful scraping in the throat, great ill-humor and
large drops of general sweat, especially in the face. Pres-
sure, with a dull digging-up sensation, on the left half of
the forehead, after dinner, when walking in the open air,
and continuing in the room. Sudden attack of contusive
pain, in a small spot of the left parietal bone. Dull pres-
sure in the right parietal bone, as of a plug being lodged
in it. Clawing aching in the left temple, first feeble, then
increasing in violence, and decreasing again. Pain as of a
blow on the right side of the head and in front. Quickly
passing pain in the right frontal eminence, as if contused.
Cramp-like drawing from the left side of the occipital bone
as far as the jaw, through the head. Jerking drawing in
the right and left side of the head. Drawing, from the
left side of the forehead into the temple, where he feels a.
pressure. Sharp stitches in the left side of the head, in
the evening when in bed. Single dull stitches in the
sinciput. Dull, corrosive stitching in a small spot of the
left parietal bone, in paroxysms. Burning pricking in the
left temple, going off by scratching. Violent boring in the
centre of the forehead, decreasing gradually and finally
disappearing. Numb pain on the vertex, as if the scalp
were being drawn together, and as if pressed upon by a
heavy weight, (a. h h.) Formication in the right temple,
aflerwards down the side of the lower jaw, with feeling of
coldness. Burning on the top of the head. Painful draw-
ing in different parts of the head. Pain of the scalp, in-
tolerable in the night, as if he were then lying upon hard
stones ; he had to sit up. Cold thrill, in the occiput,
downwards towards the cheek, where a dull burning pain
is felt ; lastly drawing in a hollow tooth. Undulating,
stupefying pressure over the right orbit. Intermittent
cramp-pain near the outer border of the right orbit. Pain
as after a blow on the right eye-brow.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Sore and gnawing sensation in the upper bor-
der of the orbit, as of an excoriation. Tensive pain in the
upper borders of the orbits, and in the eye-balls which
feel compressed. Burning sensation in the eyes, with
drowsiness, as if they would close, less pain when closing
them ; when looking steadily at a thing, sensation as it
they would run ; more in the room than in the open air.
Pressure in the eyes as if drowsy, without drowsiness, va.
2 h.) Frequent creeping in the right canthus ; he is
obliged to rub. Smarting and feeling of coldness in the
right eye. Twitching of the eye-lids. Sensation as ot
a grain of sand having got into the right eye. Painless
drawing around the left eye, seeing as if through gauze, and
sensation as of the eyes being agglutinaied. 1 he eyes
are painful when using them in the evening at candle-light,
and when exerting them ; they first itch, obliging her to
rub them ; then they suppurate, are very painful, see a
tremulous and twinkling light obliging her to close them
and making it impossible for her to see any object.

sections.label: EARs
sections.text:
Otalgia, a sort of cramp-pain in both ears.
Tearing, drawing and dull stitches in the right ear, a sort
of otalgia. Dull stitches in the right meatus audilonus.
in paroxysms. Dull, stitching jerks in the right external
ear with a feeling of numbness or coldness extending
through the cheeks as far as the lips. Sensation as it
cold air were drawing into the right ear. Burning heat ot
the ears, perceptible to the touch, with redness. Digging-
up in the right ear and jerking-drawing in the left. Cor-
rosive gnawing of the left lobule ; he has to rub. Gnaw-
ing creeping in the right meatus audilonus, U- 1 h.)
Tingling of the ears. Tingling of the ears, afterwards
tearing in the same. Whizzing in the ears, with stitches
in the head. Noise in the ears as of the wind blowing into
them, increased by the least noise to such an extent that
she has great difficulty in he.iring others Roaring in the
riaht ear. Noise in the right ear, as if of the wing of a
laraebird. Dull roaring and rolling in the car, every
moniing, and afterwards every evening after lying down
S the same hour for several weeks. Dull roaring in the
right ear, with obtusion of the head from a sort of cramp-
like pressuie. Thundering jerks in the right ear, like dis-
tant thunder.


117

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Gnawing in the outer parts of the nose as of
something acrid. Cramp-pain in the right side of the
nasal bone, with a feeling of numbness. Cramp-like jerks
in the left lfasal wing, coming and going at regular inter-
vals. Pulling sensation in the nose, above the left wing,
as if pulled by a hair, afterwards feeling of numbness as
when a hair had been pulled out.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Face pale and sunken. Pale, wretched counte-
nance, for several days. Violent heat of the face, the eyes
burnt and itched a good deal. Burning heat in the face
with glowing redness, accompanied with great dryness of
the mouth, violent thirst, headache, and vibrations before
the eyes causing giddiness ; lachrymation ; for several
evenings from 5 to 9 o'clock. Heat of the face and
the whole head ; sultriness and dull pain in the fore-
head; she knows not what to do with herself. Feel-
ing of coldness, creeping and numbness in the ivhole right
side of the face. Cramp-like, painful feeling of numb-
ness in the left zygoma. Tensive feeling of numbness in
the zygomata and mastoid processes, as if the head were
driven between screws. Dull, stupefying pressure in the
right zygoma and the whole half of the nose. Dull pres-
sure, as from contusion, in the left mastoid process, when
pressing upon it. Burning, fine stilch in the left cheek ;
he is obliged to scratch. Itching stitch in the skin of the
cheek, as if a splinter had got in, going off by rubbing.
Gnawing in the cheeks afier scratching, soon recurring.
Dull painful feeling of coldness in the chin, below the
corner of the mouth. Cramp-like jerking, at intervals, in
the upper lip, in the morning when in bed. Gnawing
around the mouth, as if sore, as when shaving with a dull
knife. Vesicles on the outer border of the lower lip,
smarting, (a. 6 h.) Vesicle on the inner margin of the
upper lip, with violent stinging pain when touching it.
Dry upper lip, as if burnt. Great dryness and roughness
of the lips. Peeling off of the lips and bleeding of the
same, for many days, with violent aching pain, and smart-
ing in the open air. Erosive sensation in the lower lip,
close below the vermilion border, as if the place had been
rubbed sore.

Jaws and Teeth. — Erosive sensation in the inner side
of the lip, with a painful feeling of looseness of the upper

Erosive sensation in the inner surface of the lower
lip, and in the gums of both jaws. Tensive feeling of
numbness in the chin, as if pressed between screws. Dull
jerks in the chin, as if it were knocked under. Dull
shocks under the chin, slowly going and coming. Cor-
rosive gnawing in the chin as if sore, he has to rub the
parts. Small aneurism by anastomosis in the chin, pain-
less, for several days. Cramp-pain in the left lower jaw.
Cramp-pain in the lower border of the lower jaw, unin-
fluenced by motion. Sudden cramp-like drawing through
the lower and upper row. Numb pain in, the left lower
row of teeih, in the morning after rising. Continual
digging-up drawing in both a hollow and sound incisor
tooth. Drawing and throbbing i.i a molar tooth, first in
the upper, then in the lower row, as if it were hollow.
Jerking drawing, first in the right side of the neck, after-
wards in a hollow tooth, lastly in the ear, where the prover
experiences dull stitches coming on with a jerk.

Mouth, Throat, and Gastric Symptoms. — Viscid and
slimy in the mouth, the whole day, especially after a meal,
also in the morning, with very bad humor. Occasional
conflux of water in the mouth. Burning under the tongue,
or in its right side. Creeping in the upper part of the

Sensation in the upper part of the tongue as it
burnt, increased by rubbing the teeth over it. Scraping
sensation in the throat, as if raw, in the evening after lying
down and on the day following, sometimes accompanied
with an irritation resulting in short cough. Painful leeling
of rawness in the throat, as if a piece of skin were hanging
down in it, between and during empty deglutition, Reel-
ing of rawness and soreness in the right half of the palate,
with creeping in the left nostril. Scraping in the throat,
as in incipient catarrh, or as after having swallowed smart-
in cr substances ; she is frequently obliged to dear her
throat, which causes a stinging pain. A concealed pain
in the throat suddenly disappears and is succeeded by a
feeling of drawing heaviness through the head. Cramp-
like drawing in the throat, around the os hyoides, as it the
parts were constricted. Pressure in the throat, as if con-
stricted. Sensation as if the uvula were elongated. Pain-
ful swelling of the right tonsil. Mucus in the throat, occa-

I sionally. Sour taste on the tip of the tongue. Continual
hunger. No appetite. Aversion to eating and weeping
mood. She relishes the first mouthfuls but she is soon
replete. She is speeddy satisfied at supper, owing to
great sadness. Aversion to tobacco. Pinching in the
umbilical region after a meal, as if diarrhoea would come

sensation in the throat. Nauseous feeling in the region of
the stomach. Qualmishness in the region of the stomach,
in the morning. Continual nausea, with great faintness,
anxiousness and a trembling sensation through the whole
body, in the forenoon. Desire to vomit, without vomiting,
coming and going increasingly, accompanied with great
qualmishness, and uneasiness in the limbs. Visible
twitchings in the region of the stomach, like jactitation of
the muscles.

Stomach— Pressure in the pit of the stomach, also
when touching it. Pressure in the pit of the stomach
after eating bread and butter, as if he had eaten something
that had not been digested. Repletion in the stomach and
abdomen as if overloaded, in the morning before breakfast,
with a good deal of empty eructations. Distension of the
pit of the stomach and the stomach itself, with a scratching
and tearing sensation in the stomach. Drawing pain, with
pressure, under the pit of the stomach, as if occasioned by
a strain. Contractive pain around the pit of the stomach,
as if she had laced herself too tightly, with a suffocative
sensation. Painful sensation around the pit of the stomach

Some three hundred years ago, when physicians were in
the habit of ruining the organism infected with syphilis by
administering large doses of mercury, it was accidentally
discovered by non-professional men that Sassapanlla
is an antidote to such mercurial poisonings. Since then
it lias been used in Europe for similar purposes but has
always been administered in decoction. In order there-
fore to obtain a powerful drug it was necessary to use
larae quantities of it, frequently an ounce and more. Al-
though having been in use for centuries past it has never
been°snspected that this root loses all its virtues by boil-
ing The patient lost therefore but little by a cheap sub-
stitute, the carex arenaria, being used in the place of the
sassaparilla root, although he paid for the latter and thus
secured enormous profits to the apothecaries. Lven
physicians have for a long lime been of opin.on that the
root of the carex arenaria might be used in the place ot
that of the sassaparilla, for this reason, that both roots are
Ion- and thin and ought therefore to have analogous
virtues ; such opinions, however, come from the common

SASSAPARILLA,

131

manufacturers of materia medica's, who will declare salix
and aesculus hippocastanum to have analogous powers to
those of Cinchona.

The truth is, that the genuine Sassaparilla, especially
the brown which grows in Hayli, is a very powerful d;ug
even when administered in very small doses, but in this
case it must not be prepared by boiling.

The medicinal virtues of dry drugs cannot be com-
pletely extracted by alcohol. To prepare Sassaparilla you

sections.text:
Violent pressure and stitching in ihe vertex, on the
right side. Violent pressure, and afterwards stitching in
the left frontal eminence. Stitching pain, with pressure,
in the region of the temporal bone, increased by contact.
Sensation as if both sides of the head were between
screws. Cramp-like headache on one side, commencing
with obscuration of sight and luminous vibrations before
the eyes ; he is like one without consciousness, has to lie
down, is unable to speak, inasmuch as every word he utters
occasions a sort of concussion in the head. Tearing in the
whole frontal region, sometimes deep in the brain. Tear-
ing, with a sort of pressure, in the whole left side of the

sections.label: head
sections.text:
Lancinations in the left vertex. Lancinalions m
the region of the temporal bone. Stitching pain in the
left occiput. Stitches extending from the right temple into
the lower teeth. Dull stitches in the left side of the head,
down to the nape of the neck. Violent stitches in the
forehead going off in the open air. Intense, fine stitches
in the middle of the forehead. Piercing stitching in the
left frontal eminence, in the evening. Violent lancinations,
with pressure, in the right side of the head, so violent that
they will cause him to shudder. Beating headache, in
the evening ; worse at night, with violent nausea and sour
vomiting. Beating in the right frontal region, while
walking in the air. Humming in the head, sensation m

SASSAPARILLA.

133

the head, as of the wind blowing into one's ear. Pressure
and cuttings in the outer parts of the head. Tearing
in the head, with pressure, in different parts, increased by-
motion and walking. Drawing, with pressure in the region
of the right temporal bone and cartilage of the ear. {Stitch-
ing drawing from the right mastoid- process to the left
frontal eminence. Stitching drawing in the region of the
right parietal and temporal bones. Dull stitching in the
left frontal eminence. Pulsative stitches in the forehead.
Burning, dull stitches in the region of the left temporal
bone. The pains about the head are worse when touch-
ing them and when walking. Falling off of the hair and
sensitiveness of the scalp when combing the hair. Itching
of the scalp, posteriorly.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Pain of the eyes when looking at something by
candle-light. In the morning the eyes are affected by
whatever she may look at. Pressure in the eye-ball, in
.the evening, while reading, the paper having a red shine.
Stitcl ling in the eyes, as if they contained dust or sand.
Stitching in the eye, when closing the lids, and violent
pain when pressing upon the closed eyes ; accompanied
with a broad, red streak from the cornea towards the outer
canthus ; the inner canlhi look blue and puffy, and the
right canthus is somewhat swollen. Continual burning in
the eye lids, sometimes alternating with aching pain.
Violent burning and agglutination of the eyes, in the morn-
ing when waking. Inflamed, dry eye-lids. Lachryma-
tion; agglutination in the morning. Twitchings in the
right upper eye-lid. Dilatation of the pupils, (a. 2 h.)
Dim-sightedness, as if through fog, or as if the eye were
covered with a gauze.

Ear— Violent pressure in the ear, extending into the
temple, where a pressing sensation is experienced. Con-
tractive sensation in the right ear. Painful contraction in
the outer right ear. Tearing with pressure in the cartilage
ot the right ear and the outer meatus auditorius. Ulcera-
tive pain deep in the left ear and around the fore-part of
the same. Violent, dull stitching, deep in the right ear.
Dull stitching in the root of the right mastoid process,
going off by pressure. Violent itching in the left outer
meatus auditorius. Drawing and visible pullings in the

134 SASSAPARILLA.

lobules. Scurf on the lobule, first burning, then itching.
Frequent tearing in the posterior side of the left ear, from
below upwards, in the afternoon. Stitching below and in
front of the left car, in the morning, (6. d.) Tingling in
the left ear. Inflammation and swelling of a gland below
the right ear, passing into suppuration.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Prickings in the tip of the nose. Itching
eruption under the nose, as if caused by an acrid discharge.
Itching of the leftside of the nose and around the eyes.
Itching eruption under the nose. Eruption in the left
nostril. Bleeding of the nose, with sensation as of small -
bubbles bursting inside of it. Bleeding from the right
nostril. Bleeding of the nose. Short-lasting heat in the
face, with sweat on the forehead and heat on the chest and
back, accompanied with prickings from within outwards,
most frequent and violent in the neck. Drawing lancina-
tions in the muscles of mastication of the right side ; they
seemed to have become convulsively contracted. Stiffness,
and tension in the muscles of mastication and the articula-
tions of the jaws, when moving them.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Contusive pain in the face in both of the lower
borders of the orbits, in the morning after waking but
only when pressing upon the parts. Fine stinging itching
in ihe face and scalp, and around the neck and shoulders,
with a feeling of great warmth in these parts, the itching
beina immediately experienced in some other place when
removed by scratching. Pale-red, a little elevated, rough
spots on the forehead, of the size of lentils, without itch-
inV Itching pimple on the cheek, spreading inflammation
far around, with violent burning, forming a thick large
scurf, and causing tearing pains in the open air, (a. 19 d.;
Pusiules in the face, without sensation. Itching pimples
on the chin. Itching pimples on the sides of the chin,
becoming shortly filled with pus. Clear vesicle on the
right side of the lower lip. Herpes on the upper hp,
wTth pain as if pricked by a number of pins.

Jaws and Teeth — Pain of the jaws as if they were
broken. Pricking pain, with pressure, in the ower and
inner border of the right lower jaw, but only when tonch-
in-r it, and when bending the head backwards. Toothache
of the right side, with creeping in the roots of the teeth ;

SASSAPARILLA. 135

the pain ceases after picking the teeth until blood comes
out ; in the evening. Tearing in the teeth, from a cold
draft or cold drink. Lancination in the gums and the root
of the last right lower molar tooth. Swelling and sore-
ness of the gams of the inner side of the lower jaw.

Mouth, Pharynx, (Esophagus. — Stitches in the

sections.label: tongue
sections.text:
Tongue coated white, in the morning, taste
natural. Aphtha? upon the tongue and in the palate.
Tenacious mucus in the 'mouth, and in the throat. Con-
stant hawking up of mucus, in the morning. Drawing
pain, with pressure, in ihe soft palate. Dryness in the
throat and stinging during deglutition, in the morning.
Pain in the right side of the neck, as if a barley-feather
were lodged there, extending upward through the ear, and
causing a slinging pain during deglutition. Cramp-like
pressing in the throat, at night. Constrictive sensa-
tion in the throat and chest, with difficult respiration.
Roughness and dryness in the throat, in the morning after
waking.

Taste and Gastric Symptoms.— Sweet taste in
mouth, for several days. Bitter taste. Bad taste, like
herbs. Metallic taste. Flat, sweetish taste. Bad, sour
'and slimy taste in the throat, in the morning, like leaven.
No appetite jind no hunger, the food had too little taste for
him, and after eating he felt in his stomach as if he had
not eaten any thing ; the stomach seemed to be insensible.
No thirst, contrary to his habit. Constant, imperfect eruc-
tations. Bitter-sour eructations, after rising, with bitter
taste in the mouth. ' Bitter eructations after drinking and
eating soup. Continual sour eructations. Gulping°up of
a bitter sour liquid. Constant nausea. Nausea when
thinking of the food which he had taken. Nausea in the
throat, owing to the rising of a disagreeable vapor into the
mouth, with obtusion of the head. Great nausea in the
morning, unto vomiting, with taste as of herbs in the

sections.label: mouth
sections.text:
Nausea and fainlness after dinner. When he eats
ever so little his stomach nevertheless becomes very much
distended, as if he had eaten a good deal. Achin-r pajn
in the pit of ihe stomach and just below the xiphoid° carti-
lage increased by contact. Frequent cramp-like sensa-
tions in the pit of the stomach. Constriction in the stom-

136

SASSAPAIULLA.

ach, "with nausea, going off in the night. Heat in the

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain in the left hypochondrium as if bruised,
with beating. Stitching in the left side of the abdomen.
Contractive pain of the intestines, afterwards violent rum-
bling round the umbilicus, or in the direction of the chest,
or again downwards as if diarrhoea would come on. Fre-
quent cramp feelings in the abdomen. Emptiness and
hollowness in the abdomen, shortly after breakfast, (3. d.)
Violent pinching in the abdomen, and afterwards painful
contraction of the sphincter ani. Aching pain in the left
side of the abdomen. Drawing in -the abdomen, with
pressure, as after a cold. Painful pressure from without
inwards and pinching in the left side of the abdomen at a
small place, aggravated only by deep breathing. Stitching
in either the right or the left side of the chest. Heat or
coldness in the abdomen. Rumbling and empty feeling in
the abdomen. Emission of flatulence upwards and down-
wards. Fetid flatulence. Pinching in the left groin.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Desire, but no stool. Great desire with con-
traction of the intestines and excessive pressure from above
downwards, as if the bowels were being pressed out, for
some minutes ; after this some stool is passed, with violent
tearing and cutting in the rectum, and this is again fol-
lowed by desire for stool, as if the rectum were being
pressed out, so that he is scarcely able to sit still on
account of the pain. Feeling of inactivity in the intes-
tines. Violent and constant tenesmus ; nevertheless the
stool is very scanty and soft, passing only with great diffi-
culty through the rectum which feels as if contracted.
Hard stool on lhe first day ; on the second day no stool at
all, on the third day, the first part of the stool was hard,
the second soft. Copious soft stool. Soft stool with
tenesmus in the rectum, (2. d.) Fainting fit during stool
in the evening. "Corrosion in the rectum during the
diarrhoeic stool. He is waked from his nightly sleep by a
sore pain in the rectum, and afterwards passes into a burn-
ing itching, continuing the whole day. Ulcer at the anus
of the size of a nut, covered with a black blister, which
speedily bursts, causing pain and emitting pus.

SASSAPARILLA.

137

Urinary Organs. — Frequent desire to urinate, with
scanly emission, the urine being clear and red. Tenes-
mus of the bladder, with cutting pain during micturition.
Pressure upon the bladder the whole day, but scanty
emission. Severe tenesmus as in gravel of the bladder,
with emission of white, acrid, turbid matter, with mucus.
Micturition with burning, once a day. Frequent mic-
turition and more copious every day. Quantity of pale
urine, depositing a sediment. Two or three micturitions
a night, emitting a quantity of urine each time. The
urine is passed without any sensation in the urinary organs.
Burning during micturition, with emission of oblong flocks.
Burning in the whole urethra, at every micturition.
Scraping sensation in the urethra during micturition.
Painful constriction of the bladder, without tenesmus.
After micturition he feels a burning and itching-tearing
pain from the glans to the root of the penis. Sharp cut-
ting stitches in the urethra, (in a few hours.) Discharge
of yellow pus from the urethra, with redness and inflam-
mation of the glans and fever in the "evening with shivering.

Genital Organs. — Intolerable stench about the geni-
tal organs. Herpes on the foreskin. Emission, (the first
night,) Painful emissions almost every night, with lascivi-
ous dreams. Inclination for an embrace, for several days,
with frequent emissions. Delaying menses. Scanty and
acrid menses, with burning of the inner sides of the thighs.
Itching eruption on the forehead previous to the menses,
for three days, burning and becoming moist after rubbing
Soreness of the bend of the right hip and desire to urinate
at the appearance of the menses. Frequent pinching in
the abdomen during the menses. Griping in the pit of the
stomach in the direction of the small of the back, during
the menses. Mucous leucorrhoea when walking.

Catarrh, Chest. — Dry coryza without sneezing, no
air through the nose. Coryza and cough. Violent cou^h
m day-time, produced by a titillating ulcerative sensation
in the fauces Dry cough with burning in the nose when
coughing. Fetid breath. Oppression of breathing. Pain-
ful constriction in the chest, frequently alternating with
sudden expansion. Pain during a deep inspiration, as if
something attached to the back prevented it. Pressure in

138

SASSAPARILLA.

the region of the sternum, worse when touching it. Stitch-
ing in either side of the chest. Violent stitches in the re-
gion of the left ribs, in the evening when sitting. Stitches
in the middle of the chest, near the slernum, uninfluenced
by breathing. Stitches in the right half of the chest, un-
influenced by breathing. Stitching pain in the left side of
the chest, when walking. Tensive pain in the outer parts
of the chest, as if too short, when laising the chest and
when walking straight, (a. 21 h.) The nipples are with-
ered, unexcitable. Itching around the nipples. Frequent
palpitation of the heart, by day. Almost continual palpi-
tation of the heart, with some anxiety.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Pain in the small of the back, extending to-
wards the genital organs around both sides of the pelvis,
worst in the night and during motion. Tensive pain at
the slightest motion, from the small of the back across the
left hip, hindering walking. Formication in the small of
the back. Small violent stitches in the back between the
scapulas. Stitches, sometimes lancinations, near the spinal
column, from the righT scapula to the last false rib, increas-
ed during an inspiration, and arresting the breathing when
taking deep breath. Pain in the back, increasing to vio-
lent pressure when stooping, less when at rest, but being
felt as a stitch whenever turning the body, (4. d.)

sections.label: Neck
sections.text:
Stitching with pressure, in the cervical mus-
cles, increased by contact and motion. Tension in the
nape of the neck, with stitches when moving the head.
Tearing in the nape of the neck, and thence across the
vertex to the right side of the forehead. Violent, continual,
drawing stitches in the right cervical muscles, from the
clavicle°to the os hyoides. Painful stitches with pressure
in the xyphoid cartilage, uninfluenced by deglutition.
Swelling of the right side of the neck, with pain when

touched. .

Upper Extremities.— Tearing in either arm, trom the
shoulder to the hands. Paralytic pain in the right shoulder-
ioint. Stitching pain in the outer part of the shonlder-
oint, going and coming like the pul*e. Dull stitches in
the upper and fore part of the region of the humerus.
Pain in the elbow as if a tendon had been strained, when
turning the arm inward rapidly. Paralytic weariness in

SASSAPARILLA. 139

the elbow-joints. Paralytic tearing in the fore-arm, near
the elbow-joint, worse in rest than motion. Tearing with
pressure in the region of the ulna, sometimes extending
to the metacarpus. Stitches wilh pressure in the muscles
covering the ulnae. Drawing lancinalions in the inner
side of the right fore-arm. Lancinalions above the left
wrist-joint, from below upwards. Tearing behind the
wrist-joint, superiorly, with drawing lancinalions towards
the finger. The hand is painful, although not swollen.
Pain as if sprained in ihe right wrist-joinl, extending to-
wards the fourth finger. Tearing in the left wrist-joint.
Stitching, wilh pressure, in ihe metacarpal bone or the
right index-finger, intermittent, for two days. Cold hands,
towards the lips of the fingers, for eight days. Itching in
the dorsum of the hand and fingers. Feeling of stiffness,
burning and itching of the hands, less when moving them.
Blister on the right wrist joint, itching, aflcrwards burning.
Stitching with pressure in the muscles of the left thumb,
both when at rest and in motion. Small stitches in the
posterior joint of the right little finger. Innumerable
prickings in the first joint of the thumb ; ihe place is after-
wards painful to the touch. Pain as of sub-cutaneous ul-
ceration in the tips of the fingers, when pressing them
upon something, or the pain is as when salt gets into a
wound. Drawing tearing in the bones of the £ourlh right
finger, increased by moving the joints. The fingers go to

sections.label: sleep
sections.text:
Inflammation of the thumb, beating and burning,
worst in the night. Herpes upon the hands. Sweaty
hands. Rhagades in the ihumb. Itching pustules on the
fingers and on other parts of the body.

Lower Extremities. — Stitching, with pressure, in the
region of the right iliac bone, in every position of the
body. Paralytic, weary and bruised in the hip-joints ; she
has to sit down, this does not afford any relief. Heavi-
ness, wilh pressure, in the left thigh, when silting or walk-
ing, without pain. Dull pressure on the right thigh, a lit-
tle over the knee joint, when sitting. Pressure on the in-
ner side of the left thigh, near the knee-joint. Tearing
wilh pressure in the upper thigh, near the knee-joint,
from below upward, and from within outward. Slitchincr'
with pressure, in the left thigh, near the patella. Single,

140

SASSAPARILLA.

intense, fine stitches in the inner side of the knee. Swell
ing and stiffness of the knee, with stitching pain, so vio-
lent that he was scarcely able to move the knee sideways.
Tearing in the knees and legs. Stiffness of the right
leg, as if the bend of the knee and calf were contracted.
Cramp along the tibia, down to the toes. Red, herpetic
spots on the calves, itching violently. Intense pain of the
soles. Violent tearing in the left sole, after midnight, Irom
the heel to the toes, followed by violent itching ; after
scratching the parts, he feels a violent stitch through the
heel, extending to the dorsum of the foot. Itching draw-
ing in the sole. Painful drawing in the dorsum of the left
foot, increasing to a jerking. Prickings above the left
outer malleolus. Stitching throbbing, with painful pres-
sure, in the inner side of the right sole, and afterwards in
the whole sole, when sitting. Tensive feeling in the mus-
cles and toes of the left foot, as if the toes would be drawn
inward, in the morning. Tensive feeling in the right heel,
as if it were swollen. Swelling and redness of the right
tarsus, with pain, increasing in the afternoon. Swelling
of the feet. Cold feet. Pressure of the toes under the
nails, as if swollen. Drawing tearing in the big toe of the
right foot.

General Symptoms. — Tearing in almost all the joints
and limbs. Drawing pains in the scapulae and lower limbs.
Sudden drawing pains in various parts of the body and
about the head. Itching of various parts of the body.
Itching of the fore-arm, the inner side of the knee, over
the bend of the knee, especially in the evening when in
bed. Slinging itching over the whole body, in the even-
ing and morning. Burning itching over the whole body,
with chills. Burning itching of the abdomen and thighs.
Red pimples of the size of a pin's head, dry, on the back
and thighs, itching only when exposed to warmth. Blotches
as from nettles, on the neck, chest, eyelids, hands, and the
whole body, intolerably itching and stinging, and burning
violently after rubbing them. Rash, whenever he goes
out of a warm room into the cold air. Herpes on every
part of the body. A number of small warts. The pus-
tules when scratched open, form ulcers suppurating for a
long time. Small pustules on the right side of the nose,

sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Irresistible impulse to kill. Self-exaltation ;
contempt for others. Arrogant, proud. Weary of every-
thing. Everything seems changed. Mental troubles, as-
sociated with suppressed menses. Physical symptoms
disappear as mental symptoms develop.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Tense, pressing pain, confined to a small
spot. Cramp-like, squeecing pain. Constriction about
forehead and right temples. Numbness, with headache.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Objects look smaller than they are. Twitch-
ing of lids. [Agar.] Eyes feel cold. Cramp-like pain
in orbits.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Feels numb. Cramp-like twinges. Roaring
and rumbling.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Prosopalgia, with' numb feeling in malar
bones, as if the parts were between screws. Pain at
root of nose, as if squeezed in a vise. Coldness, creep-
ing, and numbness, in whole light side of face. Pains
increase and decrease gradually. [5'^flnw.]

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Fermentation, much flatulence; constric-
tion; ravenous hunger; persistent nausea, with anxiety
and weakness.

sections.label: Abdomen
Stool
sections.text:
Retarjled ; faces jg ^nty ; evacuated with dif-
ficulty. Adheres to rectum, like soft clay. Sticky stool.
Constipation of travelers, who are constantly changing
food and water. Stool as if burnt.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Parts hypersensitive. Tingling internally
and externally. [Kali brom,; Orig.] Ovaries sensitive
and burn. Menses too early, too profuse, dark-clotted,
with spasms and painful bearing-down, chilliness, and
sihsttivencss of parts. Nymphomania. Excessive sex-


601

ual development; vaginismus. Pruritus vulvae. Ovar-
itis with sterility. Abnormal sexual appetite and melan-
cholia.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Tightness of thighs, as if too tightly
wrapped. Numb and weary sensation. Feel paralyzed.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text: Sleeps with legs far apart. [Chatnom.]

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, sitting and standing ; evening.
Better, walking.

tion) ; Sedum acre (sexual irritability, relieves irrita-

Grimaces. Boring in jaws. Congestion to abdomen. Colic. Hard, black, scant or soft,
